page.overview:
Who is Jérôme d'Ambrosio?

Jérôme d'Ambrosio (born 28 December 1985 in Etterbeek, Belgium) is a Belgian racing and Formula One driver of Italian descent. He previously drove for Marussia Virgin Racing in , but did not score any points. He most recently served as Reserve Driver of the Lotus F1 Team. Due to a one-race suspension of Romain Grosjean for causing a major collision at the 2012 Belgian Grand Prix, d'Ambrosio drove for Lotus at the .
